meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可打开网页、查看页面按钮和输入框,并执行点击、填表、截图等操作,把截图、PDF 或提取的信息交给你。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览网页、填写表单、截图,或做其他网页操作时,这项技能会被触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把整页截图保存下来。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器打开页面并截图。

say.text: 打开登录页,帮我填好账号密码并点提交。
say.note: Claude 会找到表单,填入内容并提交。

say.text: 提取这个网页上所有链接地址。
say.note: Claude 会读取页面链接并整理成列表。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can open web pages, inspect page elements, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, and hand you the extracted info or captured screenshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to browse the web, fill out forms, take screenshots, or perform other webpage-related tasks.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page in a browser and captures it.

say_en.text: Open the login page, fill in the username and password, and submit.
say_en.note: Claude locates the form, fills it, and submits.

say_en.text: Extract all the link URLs on this webpage.
say_en.note: Claude reads the links and returns a list.
